payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods used to reduce data sparsity effects in NMT systems, including data augmentation techniques such as Back Translation and Mix-Source methods.

claims.text: Back Translation is used to create synthetic parallel data by translating monolingual data from the target language into the source language, thus alleviating data sparsity.
The Mix-Source method combines original source sentences with target monolingual data to enhance the training data size and improve translation quality.
Using monolingual data to generate synthetic data and combining it with original bilingual data improves the performance of NMT systems in low-resourced settings.
